about: As a little child my daughter always had a happy place in mind everytime | told her about going to school.l promised her that's how it will be when she starts school.There is always a shine and pride when my daughter says that she is a Bright Rider.l have seen her grow both intellectually and emotionally with the support of her enthusiastic teachers and the care from her nannies.As a mother | want my daughter to...

As I strongly believe that a child’s development is shaped by their brain development, environment and experience with their family, friends and teachers at school. I found Bright Riders School is a wonderful place for my kid to learn, play and get educated. Bright Riders has a stress-free environment which makes it easy for child to have overall development.
